To Timothy, my well-loved child: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

記念你的眼淚，晝夜切切地想要見你，好叫我滿心快樂。

to which I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
